source: User request; map generator review; previously inspected player exports and 500 baseline bot runs on 0.274.0.
basis: Campaign I–XI change from 11–21 floors to 15 each including Warden. XII remains nine. Total 185 -> 174. Existing generated maps preserved; future maps adopt length. Per-node odds/rewards and combat coefficients unchanged.
evaluationScope: All 30 Ascendancies and representative mixed builds retain prior combat review signals. 0.274.0 Tier I simulations (500 attempts, 4,129 fights) used 11 floors and cannot establish the new 15-floor clear rates. Historical player sample has 44 Tier I fights under rules102/107/108/111, none under113. No simulations of this candidate or new measured grades.
target: Typical Arena games of 10 or more own turns and roughly 50% or better Drago clears with optimized decks remain playtest targets.

ratings.name: Paladin
ratings.setup: Combat setup unchanged. Longer I–IV offer more preparation opportunities before Ascendancy and midgame; shorter VI–XI offer fewer.
ratings.recovery: More early stops can mean more damage and more healing opportunities; fewer late stops reduce both. Final Shrine choice remains.
ratings.rareReliance: Per-offer rarity unchanged; fewer late rewards and shops may constrain rare-dependent and freely mixed engines.
ratings.scaling: Combat growth unchanged. Deck progression opportunity shifts: I–IV +4/+3/+2/+1 floors, V unchanged, VI–XI -1/-2/-3/-4/-5/-6.
ratings.rationale: No direct class/passive change. Native and mixed builds face altered acquisition and attrition. Prior Arena signal carried forward, not remeasured.
ratings.watch: Review unascended I–III survival and drafting; IV–VII setup, VIII–X maturation, XI–XII recovery and finale readiness. Compare opening, extended and 11+ turn fights separately.
ratings.pacing: Map traversal changes; no claim about combat turns.
